stock.method_en: Grade-weighted holder breadth per name this filing cycle: Σ w(grade) over buying funds minus selling funds (w: A=2, B=1.5, C=1, else 0.75); est. flow $ only where reported value/share deltas make it computable; descriptive rank — not a forecast.
stock.method_zh: 按基金评级加权的本申报周期持有人广度：买入基金 Σw(评级) 减 卖出基金（w：A=2，B=1.5，C=1，其余 0.75）；预估资金流仅在申报的市值/股数变化可计算时给出；描述性排名——非预测。

sector.method_en: Σ of per-fund quarter-over-quarter sector weight changes (pp of each fund's book) across tracked funds; positive = rotation in; current sector/theme map applied to history; descriptive — not a forecast.
sector.method_zh: 跟踪基金最新季度环比行业权重变化加总（占各基金组合的百分点）；正值=轮入；历史采用当前行业/主题映射；描述性统计——非预测。

theme.method_en: Σ of per-fund quarter-over-quarter theme weight changes (pp of each fund's book) across tracked funds; positive = rotation in; current sector/theme map applied to history; descriptive — not a forecast.
theme.method_zh: 跟踪基金最新季度环比主题权重变化加总（占各基金组合的百分点）；正值=轮入；历史采用当前行业/主题映射；描述性统计——非预测。

sector_top.method_en: Σ of per-fund quarter-over-quarter sector weight changes (pp of each fund's book) across tracked funds; positive = rotation in; current sector/theme map applied to history; descriptive — not a forecast.
sector_top.method_zh: 跟踪基金最新季度环比行业权重变化加总（占各基金组合的百分点）；正值=轮入；历史采用当前行业/主题映射；描述性统计——非预测。

theme_top.method_en: Σ of per-fund quarter-over-quarter theme weight changes (pp of each fund's book) across tracked funds; positive = rotation in; current sector/theme map applied to history; descriptive — not a forecast.
theme_top.method_zh: 跟踪基金最新季度环比主题权重变化加总（占各基金组合的百分点）；正值=轮入；历史采用当前行业/主题映射；描述性统计——非预测。

most_favored.method_en: Composite = 0.4·pct(n tracked holders) + 0.3·pct(grade-weighted breadth) + 0.2·pct(QoQ holder change) + 0.1·pct(top-10 presence), each a percentile within the candidate set; descriptive rank — not a forecast.
most_favored.method_zh: 综合分 = 0.4·pct(跟踪持有基金数) + 0.3·pct(评级加权广度) + 0.2·pct(季度环比持有人变化) + 0.1·pct(前十大持仓出现次数)，均为候选集内百分位；描述性排名——非预测。

conviction_buys.method_en: This cycle's new/add positions at conviction tier 'high' from grade-A/B funds, ranked by conviction × grade weight; buyer base rate aggregates that fund's PRIOR filing cycles only (latest cohort excluded — unresolved); descriptive rank — not a forecast.
conviction_buys.method_zh: 本周期评级 A/B 基金的高信念新建/加仓，按 信念分×评级权重 排名；买家历史记录仅汇总该基金以往申报周期（最新批次尚未了结，已剔除）；描述性排名——非预测。

asymmetric.method_en: High/moderate-conviction buys by grade-A/B funds in names held by ≤3 tracked funds, confirmed-elevated crowding excluded (names off the crowding radar pass with tier shown as n/a), ranked by conviction ÷ holder count; descriptive rank — not a forecast.
asymmetric.method_zh: 评级 A/B 基金的高/中信念买入，标的仅 ≤3 家跟踪基金持有，剔除已确认的高拥挤度（未覆盖拥挤度雷达的标的保留并标注 n/a），按 信念分÷持有基金数 排名；描述性排名——非预测。

rotating_out.method_en: Names with ≥2 tracked funds selling this cycle, ranked by the most negative grade-weighted breadth; descriptive rank — not a forecast.
rotating_out.method_zh: 本周期 ≥2 家跟踪基金卖出的标的，按评级加权广度最负排序；描述性排名——非预测。

L1.rule: new/add ≥ 1% book from low-turnover-tier funds; anchor = filing_date; measurement: does low-turnover conviction survive the lag? (both directions; NEXTL-U13 bars positive-direction promotion)

L2.rule: top days_to_exit quintile at filing cycle; anchor = filing_date; downside MAE + excess vs roster; prior: Phase-0 weak non-robust drawdown result

L3.rule: activist/flip events with signal == high; anchor = date_filed; question: classified feed reproduces announcement + drift on live data

L4.rule: top-20 by #funds holding at each filing cycle; baseline for L1–L3 comparisons; anchor = latest filing_date

L5.rule: top conviction_buys composite at each filing cycle (conviction×grade composite, weights v2026-07); anchor = max buying-fund filing_date; descriptive composite earning a forward record — pre-registered before any performance claim
